detail: National carbon market began online trading at 9:30am at Shanghai Environment and Energy Exchange (opening 48 yuan/t, close +6.7%). Start of the CEA price series; 2,162 power-sector entities covered.

MEE released notice (document dated 2021-10-23) requiring 95% of key emitters to clear 2019-2020 quotas by 2021-12-15 and 100% by 2021-12-31. Set the first hard compliance timetable; bullish for pre-deadline demand. Fetched CPNN article (2021-10-28) states release date 10月26日.
Deadline for full clearance of first-cycle quotas; MEE announced same day 99.5% compliance rate. Demand pulse ends at deadline; prices typically soften after.

MEE publicly named 4 verification/testing firms (中碳能投, 中创碳投, 青岛希诺, 辽宁东煤) for falsifying emissions data. Signaled MRV crackdown; raised expected stringency of reported emissions (bullish for effective demand, bearish for market confidence short-run).

MEE opened public comment (to 2022-11-12) on the 2021/2022 quota total-setting and allocation plan: two-year combined cycle, tightened 2022 benchmark values vs 2021 balance values. First news on second-cycle supply; benchmark-tightening signal.

MEE notice 国环规气候〔2023〕1号 (dated 2023-03-13, published 03-15) issued the final 2021/2022 allocation plan; benchmarks modestly tightened, flexibility/pre-drawdown mechanisms added; set compliance timetable (95% by 2023-11-15, 100% by 2023-12-31).

event: CCER restart signal: management measures consultation draft
detail: MEE opened public comment (to 2023-08-06) on the draft 温室气体自愿减排交易管理办法(试行) — the decisive public signal that the CCER offset market would restart after the 2017 suspension. Bearish for CEA at margin (future offset supply), bullish for offset developers.
MEE notice 环办气候函〔2023〕237号 (dated 07-14, posted 07-17) organized 2021/2022 quota clearance and confirmed legacy CCERs usable for up to 5% of obligations; pre-drawdown and hardship provisions.
MEE and SAMR jointly issued 部令第31号 (approved 2023-09-15, published and effective 2023-10-19), the legal framework for the restarted voluntary carbon market.
MEE issued methodologies for afforestation, concentrated solar power, offshore wind, and mangrove restoration — defining eligible offset supply for the restarted CCER market.
Full clearance deadline for the combined second cycle (95% milestone 2023-11-15), per the 2023-03-15 notice. Pre-deadline demand pulse in Q4 2023.

event: State Council passes ETS Interim Regulations (draft)
detail: 23rd State Council executive meeting chaired by Li Qiang reviewed and passed the 碳排放权交易管理暂行条例(草案); readout newswired same day. First binding signal of the market's first dedicated administrative regulation (penalties, legal status). Passage date verified in fetched Xinhua text of Order 775; same-day media coverage exists (e.g. Southern Metropolis 2024-01-05).
National voluntary GHG emission reduction trading market launched in Beijing (Beijing Green Exchange); first-day volume 375,315 t, 23.8m yuan. Restores offset supply channel (up to 5% of compliance).

Xinhua authorized release (dateline 2024-02-04 19:08) of 碳排放权交易管理暂行条例, signed by Li Qiang 2024-01-25, effective 2024-05-01. Elevates ETS to administrative regulation with much larger penalties for non-compliance and data fraud; bullish for compliance demand.

event: 2023-2024 power allocation plan consultation draft (banking restrictions)
detail: MEE opened comment (letter dated 06-29, posted 07-02, deadline 07-10) on the 2023/2024 power-sector plan: first quota banking/carryover restriction (carryover = base amount + 1.5x net sales during 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31), switch from supplied-power to generated-power basis, annual compliance. Banking rule incentivized surplus holders to sell — key supply-side shock.

event: Expansion consultation draft: cement, steel, electrolytic aluminum
detail: MEE opened comment (to 09-19) on the work plan covering the three sectors: 2024 as first managed year, first compliance by end-2025, intensity-based free allocation, no absolute cap in phase one; ~1,500 new entities, coverage to ~60% of national CO2.

MEE notice 国环规气候〔2024〕1号 (document dated 2024-10-15, 发布日期 2024-10-16 per MEE page, posted publicly with Q&A 2024-10-21) finalized the 2023/2024 plan incl. banking restriction; clearance deadlines 2024-12-31 (2023 vintage) and 2025-12-31 (2024 vintage).
Full clearance of 2023-year quotas required by 2024-12-31 per 国环规气候〔2024〕1号. First annualized (non-combined) deadline under the new regulation.

MEE and partners issued methodologies for low-concentration coal-mine gas/ventilation air methane utilization and highway tunnel lighting energy saving — expanding CCER offset supply. (Drafts had been consulted August 2024.)

event: Expansion work plan issued: steel, cement, aluminum smelting
detail: MEE issued the final work plan formally bringing the three sectors (incl. CF4/C2F6 for aluminum) into the ETS: 2024 first managed year (allocation = verified emissions), intensity-based allocation 2025-2026, tightening phase from 2027; coverage rises to >60% of national CO2.

event: CPC/State Council Opinions on strengthening the national carbon market
detail: First central-level (中办/国办) carbon-market document (dated 2025-05-24, publicly released by Xinhua 2025-08-25): absolute quota total control for stable-emission sectors by 2027; by 2030 a cap-based market combining free and paid allocation. Structural bullish signal — shift from intensity to absolute cap and toward auctioning.
MEE opened comment (to 2025-10-13) on the 2024/2025 steel-cement-aluminum quota allocation plan: free intensity-based allocation, 'reward the advanced, penalize the laggard' surplus design.

MEE notice 国环规气候〔2025〕2号 (document dated 2025-11-16, 发布日期 2025-11-17, posted online 11-18) issued the final steel/cement/aluminum allocation plan for 2024-2025, incl. banking base amount of 100kt for these sectors. Note: the 2025-11-16 date in circulation is the 成文日期.

event: Compliance deadline: 2024 power vintage and first industrial-sector compliance
detail: Clearance of 2024-year power quotas by 2025-12-31 per 国环规气候〔2024〕1号; also target date for first steel/cement/aluminum compliance (2024 vintage) per the expansion work plan.

event: Notice on 2026 national ETS work (next-wave sectors enter reporting)
detail: MEE notice 环办气候函〔2026〕32号 (dated 2026-01-27, posted 02-09): petrochemicals, chemicals, flat glass, copper smelting, paper, and civil aviation (>=26kt CO2e) must report 2025 emissions by 2026-03-31; 2025-vintage quota clearance by 2026-12-31; full-year verification/allocation timetable. Clear pre-expansion signal for six sectors.

event: 15th Five-Year Carbon Peaking Action Plan published
detail: State Council plan (issued 2026-07-05, published 2026-07-14) directs the ETS to gradually cover petrochemical/chemical industries and to prioritize absolute quota caps for stable-emission sectors; per-unit emission reduction targets for covered industries.

event: 2025/2026 power + 2026 industrial allocation plan consultation draft
detail: MEE opened comment (to 2026-08-05) on the combined plan: 2025-2026 power-sector allocation (benchmark method) plus 2026 steel/cement/aluminum allocation (intensity-coefficient method).

event: SCIO briefing: expansion to petrochemical/chemical, ~80% coverage target
detail: State Council Information Office 15th-FYP briefing announced the ETS will expand from four sectors to petrochemical, chemical and other high-emission industries, to control ~80% of national CO2; cumulative volume >930mt noted. Article fetched dated 2026-08-14 reporting the 08-13 briefing.

event: MEE ministerial meeting approves 2025/2026 allocation plan in principle
detail: MEE executive meeting chaired by Huang Runqiu reviewed and approved in principle the 2025/2026 power and 2026 steel/cement/aluminum allocation plan (final issuance expected shortly after the sample window). Date from secondary reports (ccement.com, search snippets); the fetched MEE news page of 2026-08-24 could not be confirmed to mention the plan, so left unverified.
